title: English National Model Exam 4 2024
description: English National Model Exam 4 2024 featuring 100 authentic questions with step-by-step solutions. Designed for Ethiopian national exam mastery.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct form: She _____ to school every day.
questions.explanation: In simple present, singular subject uses the 's' form: goes.

questions.questionText: Select the correct conditional sentence: If he ____ earlier, he would catch the bus.
questions.explanation: Second conditional: If + past tense → would + verb.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The man ____ repaired my car is my neighbor.
questions.explanation: 'Who' is used for people acting as subjects.

questions.questionText: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: I bought apples oranges, and bananas.
I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.
I bought, apples, oranges and bananas.
I bought apples oranges and, bananas.
questions.explanation: Items in a list require commas: apples, oranges, and bananas.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct comparison: This road is ____ than the old one.
questions.explanation: One-syllable adjectives add -er: narrower.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: By next week, they ____ the project.
questions.explanation: Future perfect: will have + past participle.

questions.questionText: Select the correct reported speech: He said, "I am tired."
options: He said that he was tired.
He said that I was tired.
He said that he is tired.
He says that he was tired.
questions.explanation: Present becomes past in reported speech.

questions.questionText: Choose the sentence with correct capitalization.
options: My uncle lives in addis ababa.
my Uncle lives in Addis Ababa.
My Uncle lives in Addis ababa.
My uncle lives in Addis Ababa.
questions.explanation: Proper nouns must be capitalized: Addis Ababa.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct word: She is very ____ in mathematics.
questions.explanation: 'Good' is used before nouns.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: He speaks English ____ French.
questions.explanation: Besides = in addition to.

questions.questionText: Identify the error: Everyone in the class have finished the test.
questions.explanation: Everyone is singular so it takes 'has'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct article: She adopted ____ honest child.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound, so use 'an'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct preposition: They are interested ____ music.
questions.explanation: Interested in is the correct collocation.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: She ____ TV when I called her.
questions.explanation: Past continuous describes an action in progress.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct comparison: This is the ____ movie I have ever seen.
questions.explanation: Superlative form: most exciting.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct connective: He failed the exam ____ he did not study.
questions.explanation: Because gives a reason.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct passive voice: They built the bridge last year.
options: The bridge is built last year.
The bridge was built last year.
The bridge has been built last year.
The bridge was being built last year.
questions.explanation: Past simple → was + past participle.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct reported speech: "Do you like it?" she asked.
options: She asked if I like it.
She asked if I liked it.
She asked that I liked it.
She asked do I like it.
questions.explanation: Present → past in reported questions.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: He is capable ____ doing great things.
questions.explanation: Capable of is the correct collocation.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct punctuation: "Where are you going" he asked.
questions.explanation: Question mark stays inside quotation marks.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: She prefers tea ____ coffee.
questions.explanation: Prefer X to Y.

questions.questionText: Choose the relative clause: The man ____ you met is my uncle.
questions.explanation: Whom is used as an object.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct word: The teacher gave us many ____ today.
questions.explanation: Homework is uncountable → piece of homework.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: I ____ in Addis Ababa since 2010.
questions.explanation: Since + present perfect.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct comparison: This book is ____ than that one.
questions.explanation: Comparative for long adjectives: more + adjective.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: She insisted ____ leaving early.
questions.explanation: Insist on + gerund.

questions.questionText: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
questions.explanation: Introductory 'No' requires a comma.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct reported speech: "Don't touch it," she said.
options: She told me don't touch it.
She told me not to touch it.
She told me to not touch it.
questions.explanation: Reported negative commands: told + not + to + verb.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct article: He is ____ best student in the class.
questions.explanation: Superlatives require 'the'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: They ____ the exam by next month.
questions.explanation: Future perfect.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: He is afraid ____ heights.
questions.explanation: Afraid of is correct.

questions.questionText: Identify the error: She don't like coffee.
questions.explanation: She takes 'doesn't'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: I look forward ____ seeing you.
questions.explanation: Look forward to + gerund.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct comparison: He is the ____ of the two brothers.
questions.explanation: For two items use comparative: taller.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct capitalization:
options: We visited the red sea last year.
We visited the Red sea last year.
We visited the Red Sea last year.
We visited the red Sea last year.
questions.explanation: Proper nouns: Red Sea.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: She is responsible ____ the project.
questions.explanation: Responsible for.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: The train ____ when we arrived.
questions.explanation: One past event before another: past perfect.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: The teacher asked me where ____ from.
questions.explanation: Reported question uses statement order and past tense.

questions.questionText: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
questions.explanation: Introductory 'However' requires a comma.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct conditional: If he had studied, he ____ the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional: If + past perfect → would have + participle.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: I have difficulty ____ English.
questions.explanation: Difficulty + gerund.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct verb: Either the boys or the girl ____ coming.
questions.explanation: Verb agrees with the nearest subject: girl → is.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The book ____ I bought is expensive.
questions.explanation: That is used for objects.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: He apologized ____ being late.
questions.explanation: Apologize for.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I enjoyed to read the book.
I enjoyed to reading the book.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: He ____ in Addis Ababa before he moved to Mekelle.
questions.explanation: Past perfect for earlier past action.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: I am not familiar ____ this software.
questions.explanation: Familiar with.

questions.questionText: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: My brother who lives in Adama visited us yesterday.
My brother, who lives in Adama visited us yesterday.
My brother who lives in Adama, visited us yesterday.
My brother, who lives in Adama, visited us yesterday.
questions.explanation: Non-essential relative clauses require commas before and after.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct form: She ______ to school when the rain started.
questions.explanation: Past continuous is used for an interrupted action.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct comparative form: This exercise is ______ than the previous one.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of 'easy' is 'easier'.

questions.questionText: Which sentence contains correct capitalization?
options: The nile river is the longest in the world.
The Nile river is the longest in the world.
The Nile River is the longest in the world.
The nile River is the longest in the world.
questions.explanation: Both words in a proper noun are capitalized: Nile River.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct conditional: If she had studied harder, she ______ the exam.
questions.explanation: Third conditional uses would have + past participle.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The woman ______ called you is waiting outside.
questions.explanation: 'Who' refers to people in the subject position.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am tired.'
options: He said that he is tired.
He said that he was tired.
He said he will be tired.
He said he had been tired.
questions.explanation: Present simple changes to past simple in reported speech.

questions.questionText: Choose the sentence with correct punctuation.
questions.explanation: Question mark stays inside quotation marks.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: Ethiopia, Kenya, and Uganda ______ in East Africa.
questions.explanation: Compound subject requires plural verb.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: By next week, they ______ the bridge.
questions.explanation: Future perfect = will have + past participle.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct word: She made a strong ______ in the debate.
questions.explanation: 'Argument' is the correct noun form.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct article: He is ______ honest man.
questions.explanation: Words beginning with vowel sound use 'an'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Everyone must bring their own lunch.
Everyone must bring his or her lunch.
questions.explanation: Traditional grammar uses his or her for singular 'everyone'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct comparative: This is the ______ movie I have ever watched.
questions.explanation: 'Worst' is the superlative of 'bad'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct question tag: She can drive, ______?
questions.explanation: Positive statement → negative tag.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: I ______ him for ten years.
questions.explanation: Present perfect for duration until now.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct preposition: She is good ______ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is 'good at'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The childrens' books are on the table.
The children's books are on the table.
The childrens books are on the table.
The children's book's are on the table.
questions.explanation: Correct plural possessive of child is children’s.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: She said she ______ the assignment.
questions.explanation: Reported speech uses past perfect for actions before the reporting verb.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The man ______ house we visited is an engineer.
questions.explanation: 'Whose' shows possession.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: The students were surprised because the exam was ______ difficult than expected.
questions.explanation: 'More difficult' is the correct comparative form.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He asked me where do I live.
He asked me where I live.
He asked me where I lived?
He asked me where did I live.
questions.explanation: Indirect questions use normal statement word order.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: When I arrived, they ______ dinner.
questions.explanation: Past continuous shows an action already in progress.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct synonym: 'Rapid' means ______.
questions.explanation: Rapid = fast.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct punctuation.
options: I bought apples, oranges and bananas.
I bought apples oranges, and bananas.
I bought apples, oranges, and bananas.
I bought apples oranges and bananas.
questions.explanation: Oxford comma is acceptable and preferred in exams.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: She ______ to Addis Ababa twice.
questions.explanation: Present perfect for life experiences.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: The teacher demanded that the student ______ quiet.
questions.explanation: Subjunctive form uses base verb 'be'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct relative pronoun: I met the doctor ______ treated my brother.
questions.explanation: 'Who' refers to people.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct conditional sentence.
options: If it rains, we would stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If it rained, we will stay home.
If it had rained, we will stay home.
questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present → will + verb.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Neither the students nor the teacher are in class.
Neither the students nor the teacher were in class.
Neither the students nor the teacher is in class.
Neither the students nor the teacher be in class.
questions.explanation: Verb agrees with the closest subject (teacher → singular).

questions.questionText: Choose the correct option: She sings ______ than her sister.
questions.explanation: Comparative of adverbs uses 'more + adverb'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct preposition: He is interested ______ science.
questions.explanation: Correct phrase: interested in.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct tense: She ______ English since 2020.
questions.explanation: Present perfect for actions continuing to now.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It's = it is.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct indirect speech: "Do you like coffee?" she asked.
options: She asked if I like coffee.
She asked if I liked coffee.
She asked if I was liking coffee.
She asked if I will like coffee.
questions.explanation: Present simple → past simple in reported speech.

questions.questionText: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
questions.explanation: Introductory phrase requires a comma.

questions.questionText: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: The book was so interesting that I ______.
questions.explanation: Correct idiomatic expression.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct synonym: 'Reluctant' means ______.
questions.explanation: Reluctant = unwilling.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct sentence.
options: He is the taller of the two.
He is the tallest of the two.
He is tall of the two.
He is tallester of the two.
questions.explanation: 'Taller' is used when comparing two items.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct form: She ______ her homework before dinner.
questions.explanation: Past perfect is used for earlier of two past actions.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct word: They went to the ______ to watch the play.
questions.explanation: 'Play' refers to a stage performance done in a theatre.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct form: She is the girl ______ won the prize.
questions.explanation: 'That' can refer to people in defining clauses.

questions.questionText: She would have won the medal if she ______ injured her ankle.
questions.explanation: Third Conditional (unreal past), requiring the Past Perfect auxiliary hadn't.

questions.questionText: The term for the opposing force to the protagonist in a story is the ______.
questions.explanation: The **Antagonist** is the person who actively opposes or is hostile to the protagonist.

questions.questionText: The word SUPERFLUOUS is closest in meaning to:
options: Exceeding what is sufficient or necessary.
questions.explanation: Superfluous means exceeding what is sufficient or necessary; redundant.

questions.questionText: The word BENEFICIAL is derived from the root meaning:
questions.explanation:
The prefix bene- means good, and facere means to do/make.
 Beneficial means resulting in good; favorable.

questions.questionText: The term for a discrepancy between the speaker's words and the meaning is ______.
questions.explanation: Verbal Irony is when a speaker says something contradictory to what they intend to say; often used with sarcasm.

questions.questionText: The student, ______ favorite subject is literature, is applying to university.
questions.explanation: Whose is the possessive relative pronoun, linking the student to the subject (literature).

questions.questionText: The phrase 'I'll literally die if I have to read one more chapter' is an example of:
questions.explanation: The word literally is often misused to emphasize a non-literal idea, creating Hyperbole.

questions.questionText: If the team wins the championship, they will have a celebration.
questions.explanation: First Conditional (real and probable future), requiring will have.

questions.questionText: The word AMBIGUOUS is closest in meaning to:
options: Open to more than one interpretation.
questions.explanation: Ambiguous means open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning.

questions.questionText: The sentence 'The new building is more taller than the old one' contains an error in:
questions.explanation: The use of more taller combines two forms of the comparative, resulting in a double comparative error.

questions.questionText: The primary role of adjectives in a sentence is to modify ______.
questions.explanation: Adjectives modify both **nouns and pronouns**.
